summary: A period-drama MV that produced the most analytical comment section on the channel. The largest cluster is close reading: viewers debate whether the title means 'choose me over her' or 'choose me before yourself', translate the English lyrics to settle it, and land on a self-love reading. One heavily-liked comment runs several hundred words dating the setting to the Rama VI era from the costumes and arguing the piece is about women having no agency under patriarchy rather than about a villain. The second cluster is Natty's performance — her Thai classical dance converted viewers who say they were previously indifferent to her — and the third is a demand to expand this into a full film or series. Casting Jes as the husband is treated as a running joke about his lakorn typecasting, and his own fandom shows up in English. A recurring thread says Goy now has an authorial signature and predicts she will end up producing or directing.

audience_signals: This audience will do close textual analysis when given something to analyse — several comments run hundreds of words on period accuracy and gender politics, which no other format on the channel produces
Individual member skills convert indifferent viewers: Natty's dance is credited with turning casual watchers into her fans, so member-led showcases have measurable upside
Goy is now read as an author with a recognisable style rather than a YouTuber releasing songs — commenters compare across her whole discography unprompted
Her acting work cross-feeds the music: viewers connect the song to her lakorn role and treat the two catalogues as one body of work
Guest actors bring their fandoms, including non-Thai speakers who comment in English
The group's mutual promotion is itself cited as a reason to support them — a soft asset worth keeping visible
The audience notices production detail down to a colour-grading jump at 3:06, so finish quality is being graded
content_requests: Expand the MV into a full film, series or lakorn
More arrangements using Thai classical instruments
More acting and dance showcases for Natty
Let Goy play the lead in one of her own MVs
